plan.distance: Normalized word Levenshtein distance; insertion/deletion/substitution cost 1
plan.acceptance: Successful generation and 0 < distance <= budget; unlimited has no upper bound
plan.fallback: Keep original VSR verbatim; cosmetic-only edits also keep original
plan.scope: Post-hoc development diagnostic on the same known five MELD targets, not held-out evaluation
plan.selection: All fixed budgets reported; one edit is the primary condition, not chosen by resulting WER
